events.name: Bradley Mens Basketball v Northern Iowa

accessibility.info:
ADA seating for patrons with wheelchairs, sight/hearing impaired issues and their companions
is available for all Peoria Civic Center events.
Theater Events: Accessible seating is available on house right in rows V, X, & Z.
Arena Events: Accessible seating is available on the concourse level encompassing Carver Arena.
There is a ticket limit of four per purchase for all ADA and companion seating.
If you have questions or desire further information, please contact the Box Office at (309)673-3200.

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: All will call tickets will be at the box office 1 1/2 hours prior to the event. Must have actual credit card, picture ID, and confirmation number.

venues.parkingDetail: There is plenty of onsite parking available. Event parking is $7.00 in the main Marquee Lot and $7.00 in the Fulton Lot near the theater.

generalInfo.childRule: For most events children under 2 do not need a ticket but they must sit on parents lap.
